reason: While the passage names several characters who are leaders (God/YHWH, Moses, and Aaron), it also names Nadab and Abihu—Aaron's sons—who are not presented as leaders in this text. They are mentioned by name as individuals to be brought up to God along with Moses, Aaron, and the seventy elders, but they are not described as holding leadership positions or authority. They appear as subordinate figures being included in the sacred approach to God rather than as leaders themselves.
